verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm TruffleHog runs headlessly with a single static binary, supports --json for machine-readable output, and returns meaningful exit codes (183 for findings, 0 for clean) suitable for scripting/agent parsing (trufflehog-probe-5, trufflehog-probe-6, trufflehog-probe-7). Docs also mention routing findings to Jira/Slack/webhooks (trufflehog-docs-11), which could support automated issue filing, but there is no direct evidence of a built-in 'file a GitHub/Jira issue for real findings' feature or agent-oriented workflow beyond generic webhook routing. missing for 10: explicit issue-filing integration/example, agent-specific tutorial or SDK for CI ticket creation, independent confirmation of webhook-to-issue automation.
